comment: What a wrapped tool's reply looks like once Wakeshift's block is added (docs/subscribe-from-tools.md, "The block, added automatically"): result is what the handler returned (a string, or a CallToolResult), addition is /calls/addition's answer (the top-level one unless the case has its own), wake_output says the tool opted in to typed output, want is the reply. Every SDK's tests read it; Go's skips the string cases (its handlers return a CallToolResult).

addition.text: Wakeshift: this conversation is woken by Monitor.
addition.trailer: (For Wakeshift's hook on this computer, not for you: wakeshift-beacon: aaaaaaaaaa.bbbbbbbbbb.cccccccccc)
